rows.question: How do I change the USSD language?
rows.answer: Use main-menu option 0 to change language. [field-ussd]

rows.question: How are rainfall observations verified?
rows.answer:
Rainfall summaries use dated observations and daily gauge aggregation. Rejected reports are excluded; the latest reading is used for repeated gauge/day observations. [rainfall]

Authorized staff review report quality, units, observation dates, provenance and verification status. Scientific yield comparison requires measured harvested area, comparable crop/season/year observations and sourced approved targets. [verification]

rows.question: What should I do with an unknown delivery?
rows.answer: An operator must confirm that nothing was sent before requeueing an uncertain delivery; do not resend blindly. SMS and airtime stay in dry-run until credentials, callbacks and telecom acceptance are approved. [delivery]
